Name: Large Pride Arches for Solid Foundations
Author: katriex
Description:
[center][font=Verdana][size=5][color=#f4cccc]Mod Description[/color][/size][/font]
It's the second installment of my outdoor pride furniture collection!
Here's my [b]large[/b] decorative pride arches, implemented in the game via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url]﻿﻿! [i](Technically, they're buildings.)[/i] They can be purchased from Robin for 2000g each and are built instantly. Use Solid Foundations' skins option in Robin's building menu to pick which flag you want(or don't, if you just like the plain pink one!) and place it wherever you desire! They take up a 4x1 space, with the middle two tiles not having collision so you can walk under them. These are also decently larger than [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20045]my other pride arches[/url]﻿, but they still match visually. You can definitely use a combination of both for all sorts of cool stuff!
[b]
[/b][font=Verdana][color=#f4cccc][size=5]How to Install[/size][/color][/font]
1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url]﻿﻿, which is vital for this mod to work.
2. (Optional, highly recommended) Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11158]Smart Building[/url] for ease of building outside, and to be able to place flooring underneath them.
3. Download this mod.
4. Unzip into your mod folder and enjoy!

[font=Verdana][color=#f4cccc][size=5]Additional Notes[/size][/color][/font]
1. There is no config for this mod, so if you want to adjust the purchase price of the item, you'll have to directly edit the building.json. Where it says [u]"BuildCost": 2000,[/u] change that number to whatever you desire.
2. I'm already in the process of trying to figure out what other sorts of complementary outdoor "furniture" I can make, so if anyone has ideas, feel free to throw them my way!
3. I will also probably revisit this mod and add more flags sometime! Immediately on my mind is the asexual flag, as well as perhaps some gender flags(example: I'm bigender and I didn't see much of it while browsing this site, so I really want to make one for that flag), assuming I can manage to fit them on there. This arch specifically I made larger so I'd have more room for flags, so most flags should be doable on this one. It is more detailed though, so it's a bit more work to add new flags. Feel free to request something and I'll see what I can do!
4. I plan to make a future megapack with every pride SF item I make(or maybe just every SF item I make, not sure yet). Currently it is only this item and the smaller arch. ^-^[/center]
